Create an application to help me track the cleaning of my apartment.
It should support multiple apartments, each with its own specific cleaning list.
The idea is that I can use this application to control all the cleaning tasks for the apartment.
Someone else might perform the cleaning, but I can track it with the application to know what has been done and what has not, and what is pending.
I would like it to be organized by areas, for example: kitchen, habitation, etc.
All cleaning tasks that can be done in each area should be included.
Additionally, I would like on the main screen a type of control panel where I can see the percentage of tasks that have been completed and if we are up-to-date with the cleaning or if we are behind.
Each task should have a frequency indicating how often it should be done (e.g., weekly, monthly, etc.).
When a task is marked as completed, the next occurrence should be programmed according to the frequency of that task.
Use all the ideas you have for a cleaning application, similar to those available on the market.
